mapper.sql: id, school_id, user_id, question, content, source_url, status, review_note, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, knowledge_document_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_submissions ( school_id, user_id, question, content, source_url, status ) values ( #{schoolId}, #{userId}, #{question}, #{content}, #{sourceUrl}, #{status} )
mapper.select: select from knowledge_submissions where user_id = #{userId} order by created_at desc, id desc
select from knowledge_submissions where school_id = #{schoolId} and status = 'PENDING' order by created_at asc, id asc
mapper.update: update knowledge_submissions set status = 'REJECTED', review_note = #{reviewNote}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and school_id = #{schoolId} and status = 'PENDING'
